acceptance.check: INV-ARC-AUTH-CODE (authority at H1, severity refuse): code requirement governed by the code — a guide or previous project is not the code
INV-ARC-AREA-BASIS (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): floor area missing {missing} — same building, several correct answers 20-30% apart
INV-ARC-PLOT-RATIO (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): plot ratio missing {missing} — inclusions and exclusions vary by jurisdiction
INV-ARC-TRAVEL-DISTANCE (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): travel distance missing {missing}
INV-ARC-FIRE-RATING (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): fire rating missing {missing}
INV-ARC-LEVEL (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): level missing {missing} — FFL and SSL differ by the floor build-up
INV-ARC-DISCIPLINE (provenance at H3, severity refuse): forbidden derivation: {value}
INV-ARC-CURRENCY (currency at H3, severity refuse): figure from an unverified or superseded revision

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Declarative architecture reasoning kit on the shared reasoning layer. 8 invariants declared in app/blocks/architecture/invariants.yaml across the kinds the portable spec defines (grounding, qualifier, unit_discipline, authority, provenance, currency, scope, derivation, band) and the five hooks (H0 pre-retrieval, H1 ranking, H2 tool-time, H3 answer-time, H4 export-time). Vocabulary in app/blocks/architecture/manifest.yaml. Scope refusals classify BEFORE retrieval. Fail closed: a kit that does not parse is DISABLED and refuses every statement rather than passing them through with no invariants. NO INTERVIEW HAS RUN, so every declared figure value is null and the block refuses rather than inventing one (app/blocks/architecture/KNOWN_GAPS.md). Measured by tests/blocks/test_reasoning_kits.py.

inputs.description: the operator question, classified at H0 BEFORE any retrieval
inputs.name: question

inputs.description: figures to gate: quantity, value, unit, origin, source_id, source_class, revision, qualifiers, claim_class, derivations, conditions, steps, bounds, asked_about, span, text
inputs.name: figures

inputs.description: state records by provider name, each {as_of: Unix time in seconds}; a record with no as_of, or older than its provider's max_age, is reported stale; an absent provider yields UNKNOWN, never a design-basis fallback
inputs.name: state

inputs.description: events that have happened, matched against the kit's staleness_triggers
inputs.name: events

inputs.description: subset of H0..H4 to run; all five by default, because a partial sweep is a silent coverage gap
inputs.name: hooks

name: architecture_kit

outputs.description: pass | annotated | flagged | refused, with findings, blocked_reason, hooks_run, retrieval_permitted, interview_status, unfilled_figures, unmeasured_invariants, ships and kit_disabled
outputs.name: verdict
